comment: Hand-transcribed expected cgi-exec file.exec decisions from pinned cgi-io C, helper scripts, and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: cgi-io main_exec requires application/x-www-form-urlencoded then session.access(sid, cgi-io, exec, read), then parse_command, canonicalize argv0, session.access(file, cmdline, exec) or session.access(file, exe, exec).
This oracle is bounded to the three luci-ssl libexec helpers. Other commands are HTTP 404 in this slice (lookup_executable is not a live PATH search).
Missing or empty sessionid after a valid content-type is HTTP 403, not 400.
A cgi-io exec read grant without the helper file.exec ACL is HTTP 403 Access to command denied by ACL.
Root list read/write '*' is stock rpcd.config, not a violation (expectation_id root-administration).
Do not emit dispatcher, authorization_violation, path_found, luci object grants, or execv.
shellquote and basename are not sanitizers. canonicalize_path is not a taint sanitizer.
luci-mod-status-firewall cgi-io exec is not staffed.

rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures
rpcd@d99f703 unauthenticated.json has no cgi-io exec
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_exec: session_access cgi-io exec read false -> 403 Exec permission denied
do not invent an unauthenticated helper grant
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_exec: !fields[1] -> 403 Exec permission denied
valid content-type with absent sessionid is not HTTP 400
cgi-io@31cb3c89 util.c postdecode: CONTENT_TYPE must start with application/x-www-form-urlencoded
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_exec: !post -> 400 Invalid form data
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_exec: parse_command NULL -> 400 Invalid command parameter
this slice does not live-stat lookup_executable; /bin/true is not an inventoried luci-ssl libexec helper
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_exec: !exe -> 404 Executable not found

cases.note: Executable-path ACL matches after the cmdline miss. The helper ignores argv. Not a luci-ssl grant and not a PoC.
rule_refs: cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_exec: cmdline file ACL miss then session_access(file, exe, exec)
luci@b2e0be4b syslog-wrapper file.exec is the bare helper path

cases.note: argv0 is canonicalized before the file ACL. canonicalize_path is not a taint sanitizer.
rule_refs: cgi-io@31cb3c89 util.c canonicalize_path of the leading token before session_access file
luci@b2e0be4b file ACL object is /usr/libexec/syslog-wrapper

cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_exec: file ACL miss -> 403 Access to command denied by ACL
